newsitem.title: CHINA: Buddhist monks pray for Deng to go to heaven.
newsitem.headline: Buddhist monks pray for Deng to go to heaven.

text.p: Buddhist monks in Shanghai's main Buddhist temple prayed on Saturday for Deng Xiaoping to help his spirit into heaven, a temple attendant said.
"The monks are praying for world peace and Deng Xiaoping," the attendant said. "So that Deng will go to heaven."
An official at the temple confirmed that prayers were being said for the Chinese leader, who died last Wednesday aged 92.
"As far as I know, all temples in Shanghai will be praying for Deng Xiaoping," the official said. "We decided to do it ourselves because we respect Deng as the leader of our country."

The Jade Buddha Temple, which dates from the end of the last century, is said by popular rumour to contain a secret room with altars dedicated to China's living leaders so that offerings can be made to enlist the help of the gods in their enterprises.
An official at the temple denied the existence of the altars.
